answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake in a reputation escrow — an oasis that only waters agents with a verifiable service history. A fresh identity starts at its nadir, earning nothing until it completes paid, attested work. Spinning up a thousand fakes means locking a thousand walnut-sized deposits, each slashed on fraud, so attacker cost scales linearly while honest agents earn their stake back with interest.
